title: Accelerated convergent SDK templates & field heuristics
body:
Purpose: quick, modular SDK starter bundles that field engineers and partner integrators can copy-paste into a repo and hit a stable first demo in <30m. Reasoning: we still see friction in the first 3 sessions with customers (auth, small payloads, streaming+fallback). This doc is a working capture of templates, minimal contract decisions, and heuristics that should live near code (and be usable by non-engineering PMs/SEs).

Scope (what this doc covers):
- Small, language-agnostic starter modules (node, python, go) that:
  - handle config + credential wiring
  - include a tiny smoke test that verifies token/embedding/generation paths
  - demonstrate streaming and graceful fallback to polling
- Minimal telemetry contract for first-10-requests (what events to emit)
- Field heuristics for partner demos and common failure modes
- A checklist to hand to Solutions Eng / CSM for a 30-minute demo prep

Non-goals: deep SDK design decisions, full API reference, billing/quotas docs. Those are separate.

Design principles (short):
- opinionated but tiny: one way to do auth, one tiny project layout, <100 lines to demo generation
- extensible: template points labelled clearly for custom prompts/handlers
- observable by default: success/fail metrics and request ids logged to console/structured log
- defensive: network backoff, token refresh hinting, simple retries for 429s

Template fragments (high-level):
- config.json.example (single source of runtime overrides)
  - fields: REDWOOD_API_KEY, REGION_HINT, FALLBACK_MODE
- auth/adapter.ts / auth.py / auth.go
  - wraps env -> credential provider -> client initializer
  - short-circuit if env missing and print exact next steps for non-devs
- smoke_test.js / smoke_test.py / smoke_test.go
  - sequence: init client, simple embed request, simple generation request (streamed if supported), verify non-empty result
  - exit codes: 0 success, 2 auth error, 3 network/fallback error, 4 API contract mismatch
- streaming-example.ts
  - demonstrates incremental token handling + cancellation path (ctrl-c)
- fallback-poller.js
  - when streaming fails or connection drops, show how to poll generation result until done or timeout

Minimal telemetry contract (first-10-requests):
- events to emit (console/structured):
  - sdk.start (fields: language, template-version, request-id)
  - sdk.request.sent (fields: endpoint, model, seq_len_hint, request-id)
  - sdk.response.received (fields: latency_ms, token_count, success_bool, request-id)
  - sdk.fallback.triggered (fields: reason, previous_attempt_id)
  - sdk.error (fields: code, message, phase)
- transport: console for local, structured JSON over stdout for CI, sample env var SDK_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT for teams that want to post to internal collector

Field heuristics & observed failure modes (notes from last 12 partner calls):
- Common pain: "I can't get a response when I'm behind an aggressive corporate proxy"
  - heuristic: include the proxy example in auth adapter (HTTP_PROXY env + timeout bump). Short copy to paste for partners.
- Common pain: streaming hangs silently on flaky mobile networks
  - heuristic: demo cancellation and fallback poll approach in first 2 minutes of demo. Keep fallback TTL short (20s) in demos.
- Common pain: embedding mismatch (model/version) between README sample and backend catalog
  - heuristic: template prints live model catalog check (call /models endpoint) as first step of smoke test; if mismatch, show clear action: "update MODEL_NAME in config"
- Common pain: customers ignoring token limits -> runaway cost spikes in demo env
  - heuristic: include a per-request token cap middleware in templates (DEFAULT_TOKEN_CAP=256) and show how to override per-route

30-minute demo prep checklist for SEs / CSMs (copyable):
- [ ] confirm workspace has a valid REDWOOD_API_KEY (and that key is scoped to demo org)
- [ ] run smoke_test and confirm embed+generate succeed locally
- [ ] run streaming-example and intentionally disconnect to validate fallback-poller works
- [ ] open browser to Console -> model catalog and confirm model version matches template (record name)
- [ ] enable SDK_TELEMETRY_ENDPOINT pointing to staging collector if we want logs captured
- [ ] create a short sample prompt that demonstrates edge-case (ambiguity, instructions) we want to surface

Quick copy-paste snippets (intentionally tiny — include in README):
- NODE init (pseudo):
  const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: process.env.REGION_HINT });
  // client.generate({ model: 'rwd-small-v1', prompt: 'hi' })...
- PYTHON token cap middleware (pseudo):
  def cap_tokens(request, cap=256):
    request['max_tokens'] = min(request.get('max_tokens', cap), cap)
    return request

- FALLBACK logic (pseudo):
  if stream.disconnects or error in [502,524]:
    start poll loop every 2s until status == 'done' or timeout 20s

Open questions / TODOs (for this doc and the repo):
- Should templates ship with optional example prompts for industry verticals (support, search, code)? pros: lowers demo prep time; cons: may encourage copying without evaluation. Vote: add as opt-in directory `prompts/verticals/` and tag samples with quality notes.
- Need naming convention for template versions: semver? date-ish? Proposal: template vX.Y where X increments on contract breaking changes; Y increments on non-breaking additions. Put version in README header.
- Decide whether to register templates in a Confluence registry or keep canonical source as README in the repo. I prefer repo-first + a tiny confluence index page that links to stable tags.

Short field play notes (for next 2 sprints):
- Sprint A (this sprint):
  - implement python/node/go templates, include smoke tests, add token-cap middleware, add streaming fallback example (owner: Priya)
  - add structured console telemetry and ENV toggles (owner: Samir)
- Sprint B (next):
  - add SE checklist as a generated markdown (CLI `rwd init --template demo`) (owner: Liam)
  - add CI smoke test that runs sample smoke_test on PRs to templates repo

Appendix: quick demo script for SE to read aloud (30s script):
- "This repo is a tiny SDK demo. We wire the key, run a smoke test that verifies embeddings and generation, then show streaming with a live fallback if the connection drops. Everything is observable — you can see request ids in the log and we capture the first-10-requests events for debugging. We'll also show how to cap tokens to avoid runaway demo costs."

Notes-to-self: keep README < 1 page, use code fences for all snippets, include a 1-click 'run-in-cloud' badge (we can prototype with GH Codespaces). Add a short license note for partner distribution.
